import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 1000007;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX];
    static long[] count_div = new long[MAX];
    static long[] cycle_length = new long[MAX];
    static long[] dynamic = new long[MAX];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long result = 1;
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!visited[i]) {
                int length = 0;
                long current = i;
                while (!visited[(int) current]) {
                    visited[(int) current] = true;
                    current = (k * current) % p;
                    length++;
                }
                cycle_length[length]++;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            dynamic[i] = (cycle_length[i] * i) % MOD;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            count_div[i] = (count_div[i] + dynamic[i]) % MOD;
            for (int j = i + i; j <= p; j += i) {
                count_div[j] = (dynamic[i] + count_div[j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= p; i++) {
            if (i == 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < cycle_length[i] - 1; j++) {
                    result = (result * cycle_length[i]) % MOD;
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < cycle_length[i]; j++) {
                    result = (result * count_div[i]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            result = (result * count_div[1]) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }
}
